create.name: Ronya Fakhoury Banks
create.bio:
Ronya Fakhoury Banks is the founder and lead teacher of Asheville Insight Meditation in North Carolina, a Vipassana community she has guided since 2010 under the motto 'Dharma without the dogma'. She has meditated daily for close to four decades and spent nearly two years in silent retreat, learning from many Insight teachers including Jack Kornfield, Joseph Goldstein and Chanmyay Sayadaw, and for five years she studied weekly with the Burmese monk and scholar U Jotika. She also lived for a time as a Theravada nun, completed Spirit Rock's Community Dharma Leader programme, and is now in the joint Spirit Rock and IMS teacher training.

At the centre, which meets in Woodfin on the edge of Asheville, she leads a Thursday evening sitting that is open in person and on Zoom and a Sunday morning session online, offered on a donation basis, and she has mentored students in Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach's mindfulness teacher programme for several years. Her YouTube channel holds well over a hundred of her talks on topics such as no-self, renunciation and daily practice. Born in Kuwait to a Palestinian family and raised Muslim, she brings a strong commitment to welcoming people of every background.
